guia.what: A menu of actions that appears when you right-click an element. The target element has `data-ts-context-menu`, and the items are the same ones the Menu uses.
whenUse: Offering contextual actions on an item (a row, a file, a card).
As a shortcut for power users, on top of a visible path.
The actions depend on the element that was right-clicked.
whenAvoid: It would be the only way to reach the action. Right-click isn’t discoverable on its own → add a visible `menu`.
The actions are global, not tied to a specific element → `menu` or `command-palette`.
Your audience uses touch. Mobile has no right-click, so offer another path.
dos: Duplicate anything important in a visible path. The context menu complements; it doesn’t replace.
Keep the list short and relevant to what was clicked.
donts: Don’t make it the only way to do something critical.
Don’t replicate the app’s entire menu—only what applies to the element.

teclado.action: With focus inside the area, opens the menu at its bottom-left corner and focuses the first item.
Closes the menu, and focus moves on to the next element on the page.
Closes the menu and returns focus to whatever had it when the menu opened.

nucleo: Works like Menu, triggered by a right-click. Everything Menu does, plus positioning at the pointer’s coordinates, suppressing the browser’s menu, and opening with Shift+F10 or the ContextMenu key (at the bottom-left corner of the area, with focus on the first item).
